title: docs(pm-dispatch): a new area label for a seated lane is a partition of the same seat
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYMxVr4whKU7SgYTUvvzVkx)_

Fixes #35570

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: the maintainer (Sales): objectstack project chat, 2026-11-19 15:40Z, 「你应该用同一个座位，之需要不同的分区啊」 (ruling record 7030459053); and decision card in the card's project thread, 2026-11-20 22:02Z, asked 「确认「默认一座位,你明说开座位才加」这句规则怎么落地」, he chose 「确认这句规则」 (ruling record 7051715005)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；以后你说「再开一个 area:X」，已在座的座位把它加进自己的接卡面、在席内加一个分区，不再另开座位、信箱和巡检。
- 为什么做：属于车队技能文字整理；此前协调者把「再开一个专题」读成了「再开一个座位」，而你的本意是同一座位加分区。
- 出错会怎样：只是协调者与座位读的规则文字；写错了最多再次多开或少开一个座位，可直接撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么：无；「默认一座位，你明说开座位才加」这句你已在 2026-11-20 22:02Z 的决策卡上确认。

## What changes

Skill text only. Four rule lines are added and one existing line gains a qualifier, in three files of the pm-dispatch skill; the three matching byte-ceiling rows move with them, and the comment above the ceiling map now names them.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md`, section 一, two lines added after the line on which lanes a project runs:

> - 一个项目在一条车道默认一席,维护者明说开座位(「开座位」「再开一个座位」)才加席。维护者对本项目已有席的车道再点 `area:*`(「接 area:X」「再开一个 area:X」)⇒ 交给该席:席把 `area:X` 写进座位贴说明段的接卡行,照 `area-lease.md` 分区(自开一区或并入现有区);⛔ 不另开席位线程、座位贴、信箱或巡检。
> - 车道没有本项目的席时照常开席;下文 L2 积压加开照旧。

The same section, one line qualified so that it no longer reads as "a new intake means a new seat" (it is the last line of the L2 backlog rule):

> - before: `- 新席坐空座、开信箱、按认领分行;…`
> - after: `- L2 新席坐空座、开信箱、按认领分行;…`

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md`, 形态, one line added after the seat-name line:

> - 一个项目在本车道默认一席(维护者明说开座位才加席);席接哪些 `area:*` 是该席的属性,写在座位贴说明段的接卡行。维护者再点一个 `area:*` 是改该席的接卡面并在席内分区,⛔ 不是加席(`coordinator.md` 一)。

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, first line of 分不分区:

> - 区是席内的文件簇租约;`area:*` 是卡的产品专题标签,由席的座位贴接卡行点名。两者不是一个词:一个 `area:*` 可切成几区,也可并入现有区。

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: three `CEILINGS` rows move (table below), each with a one-line comment, and the paragraph above the map gains one sentence saying that three rows were later raised by an ordinary ruled raise, each named at its row. Comment text and three integers; no logic changes.

The existing lines 「可多席、多账号」 and 「开席、加席、收席由维护者召唤」 are untouched and stay true: several accounts may each hold a seat on the lane, and the maintainer's word for a seat adds one.

## Why

The coordinator read 「再开一个 area:fleet」 as an order for a new seat and opened a second seat thread, mailbox and patrol for one account on one lane. The text never said that one project holds one seat per lane by default, and it used 区 for file-cluster leases next to the `area:*` product labels with no line telling them apart.

## Ratchet raise

The three files sat at byte headroom 0. The raise is the ordinary ruled raise the ratchet header allows. The ruling of record that orders this text into the files is comment 7030459053 on the card, which transcribes the maintainer's words: 「你应该用同一个座位，之需要不同的分区啊」 (2026-11-19 15:40Z) and the order to write it now, 「35570 升级 p1 立刻派发」 (2026-11-20 04:21Z).

Measured with `wc -c` at base `a457b5157` and at head `dc4ff6f57`; each row moves by exactly the measured delta, and no other row moves:

| File | Base bytes | Head bytes | Delta | `CEILINGS` row |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|:---|
| `references/coordinator.md` | 3781 | 4265 | +484 | 3781 → 4265 |
| `references/lanes/objectstack.md` | 2270 | 2540 | +270 | 2270 → 2540 |
| `references/area-lease.md` | 6401 | 6586 | +185 | 6401 → 6586 |
| Total | 12452 | 13391 | +939 | |

Each moved row carries a one-line comment naming ruling record 7030459053. The first head measured +486, +235 and +185 (+906); the review round below changed the first two.

## Review

- Head `2d25ef2`: L1 answered REWORK in comment 7031028295 with one should-fix, S1 (the absolute "at most one seat" contradicted the maintainer's explicit order for a seat). The contract review brief is comment 7030854050 and its record is comment 7031081983: PASS, nits N1 to N4.
- This head answers S1 and N4. S1: the rule is now a default with its one exception, in both files, and `coordinator.md` says each thing once. N4: the paragraph above the ceiling map names the three ruled raises. N2 is the same point as S1.
- Same head, after `main` gained the rule-change line: the re-read record 7031988789 is PASS with `Rule-change-verified: yes`, because the clause "one seat by default, a seat is added only on the maintainer's explicit word" was not in the 15:40Z sentence. The maintainer confirmed that clause on 2026-11-20 22:02Z (ruling record 7051715005 on the card); the `Ruling-ref:` line above now quotes both rulings. The head has not moved.
- N1 and N3 are left. N1 (the seat post protocol does not name the 接卡行) is a follow-up card for the seat. N3 (the partition outcome is spelled three ways) is an accepted deviation.

## Verification

All readings are from head `dc4ff6f57`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: exit 0. `check-skill-line-ratchet self-test: 116 cases pass`; `coordinator.md is 4265 bytes (ceiling 4265; headroom 0)`; `lanes/objectstack.md is 2540 bytes (ceiling 2540; headroom 0)`; `area-lease.md is 6586 bytes (ceiling 6586; headroom 0)`.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: exit 0. `130 file(s) clean`.
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`: exit 0. `31 cases pass`.
- `pnpm check:scripts-symbol-anchors`: exit 0. `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` at `03bce5c22a` and 0 open PR heads sharing a file.
- The other derived families ran at the first head (40 derived, 40 run; details in the report comment on the card) and were not run again locally on this head. Read them from this head's check-runs.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` prints headroom 0 for the three files above, and `git diff a457b5157 dc4ff6f57 --shortstat` answers 4 files changed, 10 insertions, 5 deletions.

Read first: the two added lines in `coordinator.md` (the rule itself), then the qualifier on the L2 line just below them.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope note: the default speaks of lane seats. The `l2-review` backlog seats the coordinator may add are untouched by this PR; the new text keeps that rule by name (「下文 L2 积压加开照旧」) and it is not a new rule.
- 「接卡行」 names the line of the seat post's 说明段 that lists the `area:*` the seat takes in. `seat-post-protocol.md` does not define that line by name today and is outside this card's file fence (N1 above).
- No changeset: the diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, and neither ships in a package.
- This PR touches a governed surface. It stays a draft for its tier's review record.
